title: From the shared darkroom: choosing prints for Open Studio
titleZh: 共用暗房通知：為工作室開放日選擇相片
passage:
SHARED DARKROOM | Open Studio preparation note

On Saturday, visitors will see examples of how the same negative can produce different prints. Each participant can hang one finished print plus one test strip showing an earlier decision. A test strip is the narrow piece of paper used to try several settings; it is not a finished print. If you use a test strip, hang it below your print and explain what you changed.

You may show a print made from a negative borrowed from the club’s teaching file. Label it “Teaching file,” and display the print only inside the studio. The preparation team numbers the slots on its layout sketch, not on the prints. Write your name on a removable card next to your work. Do not write on the print itself. If two participants share a given name, the guide will add their last initials to the cards. The printed program keeps the entries in wall order, not in alphabetical order.

Before we open, volunteers will take two photographs for the setup record: a wide view of the wall and a close view of the label cards. The wide image shows the arrangement, but it may not show card text clearly. Take and keep a new pair even if only one corner of the wall has changed. For no-change days, write “same layout” in the log; there is no need to take new photos.

Please reserve your wall space with the print’s provisional title by Thursday. If you change the title after that, keep the same wall space and give the guide the new title at the door. If you change to a different print, you must send its width first so we can check whether it fits before we make a new label.
passageZh:
共用暗房｜工作室開放日準備通知

星期六，訪客會看到同一張底片如何印出不同的相片。每位參加者可以掛一張完成的相片，再加一條呈現先前取捨的試印紙條。試印紙條是用來測試多種設定的窄紙，不算完成的相片。如果要展示試印紙條，請把它掛在相片下方，並說明你調整了什麼。

你可以展出用社團教學檔案中的借用底片印成的相片。請標上「教學檔案」，且只在工作室內展示。準備團隊會在配置草圖上為位置編號，不會在相片上編號。請將名字寫在作品旁可取下的卡片上，不要寫在相片本身。如果兩位參加者的名相同，導覽員會在兩張卡上各加姓氏的首字母。紙本節目單依展牆的排列順序列作品，不按字母排列。

開門前，志工會拍兩張照片做布展紀錄：一張拍整面牆，一張近拍各張標示卡。全景照可呈現排列方式，但不一定看得清楚卡上的文字。即使展牆只有一角改動，也要重拍這兩張並保存。如果當天沒有變動，請在紀錄簿寫「配置相同」；不必重拍。

請在星期四前用相片的暫定標題預留牆面位置。如果之後更改標題，請保留原本的位置，並在入口把新標題告訴導覽員。如果改成另一張相片，則必須先寄給我們新相片的寬度；我們要確認放得下，才會製作新標籤。
